title: Neural Matrix Delivery: 5,000 cr once; 8 phase matrix handed out at the accept, delivered to Sirius Observatory Station (Solarian, 7 jumps from Synchrony)
note: 2026-11-16 19:04 UTC (Mercury): the test of one trader, on the Fleet Admiral's word for this mission's own goods (requests.log ENT-155, rule F13). The accept at Central Nexus (2026-11-16 12:36 UTC, empty hold) put 8 phase matrix (size 2, base value 1,400 each) into the hold; they lie in the test pilot's storage at Synchrony Hub since, and `requires.stored` sends only that pilot. The hand flight of 19:02 UTC did not leave the dock: 'A loop is running on this account' (the pilot's mining loop had not stopped). Stops: withdraw at Synchrony Hub, hand in on docking at Sirius Observatory Station (the base id stands for the POI id: not read), read the Nova Terra Central book on the way back, store at Synchrony Hub. A route for every pilot the board offers it to (accept at Central Nexus first) is written after this RESULT line.
